description: This file contains implementation of ASN.1 encoding and decoding functions, including object size calculations, string management, and ASN.1 object parsing, as part of the BoringSSL cryptographic library.

methods.name: ASN1_get_object
methods.description: Parses ASN.1 object header, extracting length, tag, and class information.

methods.name: ASN1_put_object
methods.description: Encodes ASN.1 object header with specified constructed flag, length, tag, and class.

methods.name: ASN1_put_eoc
methods.description: Writes End-Of-Content marker for indefinite length ASN.1 objects.

methods.name: asn1_put_length
methods.description: Helper function to encode ASN.1 length field.

methods.name: ASN1_object_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of an ASN.1 object given its parameters.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_copy
methods.description: Copies ASN1_STRING data and type from source to destination.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_dup
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an ASN1_STRING.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set
methods.description: Sets ASN1_STRING data with provided buffer and length.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_set0
methods.description: Sets ASN1_STRING data and frees previous data.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_new
methods.description: Allocates a new ASN1_STRING of type OCTET STRING.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_type_new
methods.description: Allocates a new ASN1_STRING with specified type.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to ASN1_STRING data.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_get0_data
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to ASN1_STRING data.
